label: Per-candidate inversion age (3-bracket)
description: Per-candidate age estimate via BUSCO 4D substitutions. 3 brackets (low/mid/high μ).

label: Age-model best-fit suggestion
description: Per-candidate suggested μ model (low/mid/high) based on dxy + private-variant pattern.

label: Per-candidate polarity verdict
description: Polarity verdict: which haplotype class is HOM_REF vs HOM_INV. Output of polarize_synteny_vote OR polarize_msa_stacked (different methods, same verdict layer).

label: Sub-PCA on derived-only samples
description: Sub-structure within the INV class — haplotype clusters / nested rearrangements / sublineages.

label: Per-candidate haplotype network
description: Minimum-spanning haplotype network of INV chromosomes.

label: Per-window mosaicism leakage
description: Per-sample per-window mosaic-call + summary leakage score.

label: Kinship-downweighted ancestry layers
description: Cleaned ancestry weights — close relatives + hatchery duplicates downweighted.

label: Per-chromosome event-tree (relative ordering)
description: Relative ordering of inversion events on the same chromosome.

label: Per-candidate archaeology synthesis card
description: Step-6 verdict — polarity + age + integrity + mosaicism + frequency + π/dXY/FST + private/fixed + confidence.

label: Copy-origin painting (SPEC)
description: SPEC ONLY. Refines polarity verdicts when implemented.
